## Governance, and the whales

- JuMP, SciML and Turing all wrote their governance down after they were
  already large. None of them says how an org starts, or how a package joins
  one
- 🐋 Every project I have worked on has ended up with one person doing most
  of it. I started `epinowcast` in 2021 partly to avoid what had happened in
  `EpiNow2`, and it happened again
- 🐳 Julia's composability does not fix that. The median Julia package has
  two contributors, and this ecosystem has its own whales
- Here the whale is me and a subscription

## How do you reach users who do not care about dispatch?

- They want things that work, with little time and less money, mostly in R
  and in the middle of an outbreak response
- Multiple dispatch and the type system are not features to them. They are
  the reason the install is unfamiliar
- Most of them will never install Julia, so whatever we build has to be
  callable from R
